_comment: Sinai, June 1967. Generated by mapgen from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 and OpenStreetMap (data/mapgen-sinai67.json; see LICENSE-DATA.md); roads of 1967 from dated maps (docs/reports/2026-11-26-roads-sinai67.md). Control: the 1949 armistice line (the 1906 border Rafah–Taba; the Gaza Strip held by Egypt), simplified to hexes; water is nobody's. Edited by hand (stage 4, step 6): the Mitla–Giddi ridge along 33° E (rows 13–18 of column 8) as mountains with the Mitla (8,17) and Giddi (8,15) passes where the 1967 roads cross it; El Arish (17,4) a coastal town; fortified areas at Umm Katef (21,7) and the Rafah junction (22,4).

historical_roads.name: Эль-Кантара — Румани — Бир-эль-Абд — Эль-Ариш — Шейх-Зувейд — Рафах

East of 34.07 (beyond sheet 35) traced on the 1956 North Sinai sheet 33 El Arish, where it is the same red road via Sheikh Zuweid to the edge at 34.22; last 3 km into Rafah from the Palestine 1:100k sheet 14. Points read at ~0.005 deg from georeferenced scans.
